sql: SELECT TOP 10 p.SKU AS sku, p.ProductName AS name, p.PimProductId AS productId, rc.cnt AS requiredAddOnCount, MAX(gp.RetailPrice) AS retailPrice, MAX(gp.SalesPrice) AS salesPrice, MAX(br.brandName) AS brandName, MAX(cat.categoryName) AS categoryName, MAX(sd.val) AS shortDescription, MAX(tr.q1) AS tier1Qty, MAX(tr.tp1) AS tier1Price, MAX(tr.q2) AS tier2Qty, MAX(tr.tp2) AS tier2Price, MAX(tr.q3) AS tier3Qty, MAX(tr.tp3) AS tier3Price, MAX(ad.aid1) AS addOn1ProductId, MAX(ad.anm1) AS addOn1Name, MAX(ad.apr1) AS addOn1Price, MAX(ad.aid2) AS addOn2ProductId, MAX(ad.anm2) AS addOn2Name, MAX(ad.apr2) AS addOn2Price, MAX(ad.aid3) AS addOn3ProductId, MAX(ad.anm3) AS addOn3Name, MAX(ad.apr3) AS addOn3Price FROM dbo.ZnodePimProduct p INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePublishState ps ON ps.PublishStateId = p.PublishStateId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodeInventory i ON i.SKU = p.SKU INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalWarehouse pw ON pw.WarehouseId = i.WarehouseId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortal po ON po.PortalId = pw.PortalId CROSS APPLY (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT rq.PimAddOnProductId) AS cnt FROM dbo.ZnodePimAddOnProduct rq WHERE rq.PimProductId = p.PimProductId AND rq.RequiredType = @requiredType) rc OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 gpr.RetailPrice, gpr.SalesPrice, gpr.PriceListId FROM dbo.ZnodePrice gpr INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePriceList gpl ON gpl.PriceListId = gpr.PriceListId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePriceListPortal gpo ON gpo.PriceListId = gpl.PriceListId WHERE gpr.SKU = p.SKU AND gpo.PortalId = po.PortalId AND (gpl.ActivationDate IS NULL OR gpl.ActivationDate <= @now) AND (gpl.ExpirationDate IS NULL OR gpl.ExpirationDate >= @now) AND (gpr.ActivationDate IS NULL OR gpr.ActivationDate <= @now) AND (gpr.ExpirationDate IS NULL OR gpr.ExpirationDate >= @now) ORDER BY gpo.Precedence, gpl.PriceListId, gpr.PriceId) gp OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 bl.BrandName AS brandName FROM dbo.ZnodeBrandDetails bd INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodeBrandDetailLocale bl ON bl.BrandId = bd.BrandId WHERE bd.BrandCode = p.Brand AND bl.LocaleId = @localeId ORDER BY bd.BrandId, bl.BrandDetailLocaleId) br OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 ce.CategoryName AS categoryName FROM dbo.ZnodePublishProductEntity ce INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePublishVersionEntity cv ON cv.VersionId = ce.VersionId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalCatalog cc ON cc.PublishCatalogId = ce.ZnodeCatalogId WHERE ce.ZnodeProductId = p.PimProductId AND cc.PortalId = po.PortalId AND cv.RevisionType = @publishState AND cv.IsPublishSuccess = @isActive AND ce.IsActive = @isActive AND ce.IsObsolete = @notObsolete AND ce.LocaleId = @localeId ORDER BY ce.VersionId DESC, ce.ProductIndex, ce.PublishProductEntityId) cat OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 COALESCE(sta.AttributeValue, sal.AttributeValue) AS val FROM dbo.ZnodePimAttributeValue sav INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAttribute spa ON spa.PimAttributeId = sav.PimAttributeId LEFT JOIN dbo.ZnodePimProductAttributeTextAreaValue sta ON sta.PimAttributeValueId = sav.PimAttributeValueId AND sta.LocaleId = @localeId LEFT JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAttributeValueLocale sal ON sal.PimAttributeValueId = sav.PimAttributeValueId AND sal.LocaleId = @localeId WHERE sav.PimProductId = p.PimProductId AND spa.AttributeCode = @shortDescriptionCode ORDER BY sav.PimAttributeValueId) sd OUTER APPLY (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN tq.rn = @n1 THEN tq.Quantity END) AS q1, MAX(CASE WHEN tq.rn = @n1 THEN tq.Price END) AS tp1, MAX(CASE WHEN tq.rn = @n2 THEN tq.Quantity END) AS q2, MAX(CASE WHEN tq.rn = @n2 THEN tq.Price END) AS tp2, MAX(CASE WHEN tq.rn = @n3 THEN tq.Quantity END) AS q3, MAX(CASE WHEN tq.rn = @n3 THEN tq.Price END) AS tp3 FROM (SELECT t.Quantity, t.Price, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t.Quantity, t.PriceTierId) AS rn FROM dbo.ZnodePriceTier t WHERE t.PriceListId = gp.PriceListId AND t.SKU = p.SKU) tq) tr OUTER APPLY (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN ax.rn = @n1 THEN ax.id END) AS aid1, MAX(CASE WHEN ax.rn = @n1 THEN ax.nm END) AS anm1, MAX(CASE WHEN ax.rn = @n1 THEN ax.pr END) AS apr1, MAX(CASE WHEN ax.rn = @n2 THEN ax.id END) AS aid2, MAX(CASE WHEN ax.rn = @n2 THEN ax.nm END) AS anm2, MAX(CASE WHEN ax.rn = @n2 THEN ax.pr END) AS apr2, MAX(CASE WHEN ax.rn = @n3 THEN ax.id END) AS aid3, MAX(CASE WHEN ax.rn = @n3 THEN ax.nm END) AS anm3, MAX(CASE WHEN ax.rn = @n3 THEN ax.pr END) AS apr3 FROM (SELECT ao.PimProductId AS id, ao.ProductName AS nm, MAX(apx.price) AS pr, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ap.DisplayOrder, apd.DisplayOrder, ao.PimProductId) AS rn FROM dbo.ZnodePimAddOnProduct ap INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAddOnProductDetail apd ON apd.PimAddOnProductId = ap.PimAddOnProductId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimProduct ao ON ao.PimProductId = apd.PimChildProductId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodeInventory ai ON ai.SKU = ao.SKU INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalWarehouse apw ON apw.WarehouseId = ai.WarehouseId CROSS APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 COALESCE(xr.SalesPrice, xr.RetailPrice) AS price FROM dbo.ZnodePrice xr INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePriceList xl ON xl.PriceListId = xr.PriceListId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePriceListPortal xo ON xo.PriceListId = xl.PriceListId WHERE xr.SKU = ao.SKU AND xo.PortalId = po.PortalId AND xr.RetailPrice > @zero AND (xl.ActivationDate IS NULL OR xl.ActivationDate <= @now) AND (xl.ExpirationDate IS NULL OR xl.ExpirationDate >= @now) AND (xr.ActivationDate IS NULL OR xr.ActivationDate <= @now) AND (xr.ExpirationDate IS NULL OR xr.ExpirationDate >= @now) ORDER BY xo.Precedence, xl.PriceListId, xr.PriceId) apx WHERE ap.PimProductId = p.PimProductId AND ao.IsActive = @isActive AND apw.PortalId = po.PortalId GROUP BY ao.PimProductId, ao.ProductName, ap.DisplayOrder, apd.DisplayOrder) ax) ad WHERE p.ProductType = @productType AND p.IsActive = @isActive AND ps.PublishStateCode = @publishState AND po.StoreCode = @store AND EXISTS (SELECT pe.PublishProductEntityId FROM dbo.ZnodePublishProductEntity pe INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePublishVersionEntity ve ON ve.VersionId = pe.VersionId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalCatalog pc ON pc.PublishCatalogId = pe.ZnodeCatalogId WHERE pe.ZnodeProductId = p.PimProductId AND pc.PortalId = po.PortalId AND ve.RevisionType = @publishState AND ve.IsPublishSuccess = @isActive AND pe.IsActive = @isActive AND pe.IsObsolete = @notObsolete AND pe.ProductIndex >= @minProductIndex) AND rc.cnt >= @minRequiredAddOns AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT cl.PimProductTypeAssociationId FROM dbo.ZnodePimProductTypeAssociation cl INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimProduct cp ON cp.PimProductId = cl.PimParentProductId WHERE cl.PimProductId = p.PimProductId AND cp.ProductType = @configurableType) AND CHARINDEX(@space, p.SKU) = @zero AND (@preferred IS NULL OR p.SKU = @preferred) GROUP BY p.SKU, p.ProductName, p.PimProductId, rc.cnt HAVING SUM(i.Quantity) >= @quantityUsed ORDER BY p.SKU
